source_lineage.excerpt:
PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:
   *
   * Potentially all Application servers (WebSphere + other J2EE
   * servers) monitored by ITCAM AD v7.1 or v6.1
   *
   ****************************************************************
   *
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:
   *
   * In rare cases it has been noticed that the shutdown of an
   * application server instance monitored by ITCAM for AD v7.1
   * or ITCAM for WebSphere/J2EE v6.1 can be very slow.  This is
   * due to an explicit garbage collection call that is done
   * by ITCAM when the Java VM's death handler is invoked.
   *
   ****************************************************************

*  This explicit garbage collection is not required to be
   performed and hence been removed for this APAR fix.

PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:
   *
   * ITCAM Data Collector connecting to TEMA and collecting Request
   * Analysis data.
   *
   ****************************************************************
   *
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:

   * In some cases when ITCAM for WebSphere Data collector is
   * configured for TEMA monitoring, TEMA can fail to initialize
   * request data monitoring completely and Data collector might
   * start leaking ThreadWorker objects.
   *
   * This can also happen when the request analysis is not
   * on-demand and there are no history or situations on the
   * Request analysis workspaces and the corresponding
   * workspaces are not refreshed by the user.
   *
   ***********************************************************
